predicted_reason: Printed tissue paper of 17 gsm in sheets (not rolls) falls under Chapter 48 heading 4802 for uncoated paper and paperboard of a kind used for writing, printing or graphic purposes or other special paper; sub-heading 4802.30 covers 'Light-weight coated...
